description: This file defines the MarketplaceCommerceAnalyticsClient class, a client for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics service in PHP. It extends the AwsClient class and specifies methods related to data set generation and support data export.

classes.name: MarketplaceCommerceAnalyticsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics service via AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods for generating data sets and starting support data export asynchronously.

methods.name: generateDataSet
methods.description: Synchronous method to generate a data set for AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics.

methods.name: generateDataSetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to generate a data set for AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics.

methods.name: startSupportDataExport
methods.description: Synchronous method to start support data export.

methods.name: startSupportDataExportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to start support data export.
